_doc: Everyday categories for a driver. Read at build time (tag rules -> which POIs belong to which category) and copied into the search database (terms -> category) so the device only needs the database.
match: a list of rules; a POI belongs to the category if ANY rule holds. A rule holds if ALL its entries hold.
"key": ["a", "b"]   tag is one of the values
"key": "*"          tag present with any value other than "no"
"key~": "regex"     tag value matches the regex (case-insensitive, Python re.search)
"!key": value/list/*  the negation of the same test

terms: everyday US words written for this project; a term written as ["word", 0.8] has a lower weight (the category is offered, but ranks below categories where the word weighs 1.0). Extra words copied from the iD tagging schema (see attribution) live in the generated file categories_idterms.json, made by seed_categories.py from the presets in id_presets, minus id_terms_exclude and the global exclude list. Never edit that file by hand.
unnamed: true lets unnamed, unbranded POIs of this category into the index (shown with the category label as title). Other categories need a name or brand.
facet: true marks a property of a POI that already has a better primary category (diesel at a gas station): searchable, never the displayed category.

umbrella: true means the category groups others (e.g. food) and is never shown as a POI's primary category. The primary category of a POI is the first non-umbrella category in file order that matches, so more specific categories come first.

in_park: true (named natural places a driver heads to: beaches, waterfalls, caves, peaks): such a POI inside named parks, nature reserves or protected areas (up to the three smallest that hold it) is also found as '<park> <label>' and '<park> <name>', with the park's name as written and without a trailing 'State Park', 'Park', ... (build.py PARK_SUFFIXES): 'presque isle beach' finds the beaches of Presque Isle State Park. Natural objects need a rule here to be kept at all: osm_extract.py keeps only the natural=* and waterway=* values these rules name.
attribution: The words in categories_idterms.json (id_terms) are copied from the iD tagging schema, @openstreetmap/id-tagging-schema 7.3.0 (dist/translations/en.json: preset name, aliases and terms).
